text: Renting out your Dubai apartment short-term? Here's what nobody tells you.
A referral agent is just a middleman. He brings you to a management company, and gets paid for it.
The company pays him: up to five thousand dirhams, or a cut of your rental income. Sometimes, you pay too.
And the management company already takes fifteen to twenty-five percent.
So, you don't need an agent. Check the company's license, compare the terms, and sign directly.
